Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. We also understood that helping people select, purchase and finance one of the most important tools of your daily life is a valuable pursuit. Our priority is and has always been making sure your new or used-car buying experience is both satisfying and successful. Within the Cardinale Automotive Group, we know that satisfying a wide range of needs requires a diversity of quality cars. We offer new Audi, BMW, GMC, Harley Davidson, Hyundai, Mazda, Nissan, Toyota and Volkswagen cars, along with used cars, trucks and SUVs by top manufacturers. We are committed to helping you find the right car, assisting you in choosing the right financing options, and becoming your trusted automobile dealer. Our relationship begins with our introduction and continues through the purchase, the financing, the service of the car and beyond. We look forward to developing an outstanding relationship with you.

description: LUXURIOUS, ELECTRIFYING, REVOLUTIONARY, ONE-OWNER, OUTSTANDING! The 2023 Mercedes-Benz EQS 580 4MATIC Sedan represents the pinnacle of Mercedes-Benz electric luxury. Combining extraordinary refinement, breathtaking technology, impressive performance, and cutting-edge electric propulsion, the EQS was engineered to redefine what a flagship luxury sedan can be in the electric era. As the range-topping EQS 580 4MATIC, this example delivers exceptional comfort, all-weather capability, and an unmistakably futuristic driving experience. Few vehicles occupy the same space as the EQS. Competitors such as the Tesla Model S Plaid, BMW i7, Lucid Air, Porsche Taycan, and Audi e-tron GT each offer their own interpretation of luxury EV motoring, but the EQS remains uniquely focused on comfort, innovation, and effortless long-distance travel. The critics often praised the EQS for its whisper-quiet cabin, exceptional ride quality, advanced technology, and impressive electric driving range. Reviews routinely highlighted its luxurious interior, innovative features, and flagship-level refinement. Recognized as one of the world's premier electric luxury sedans. Praised extensively for ride comfort and cabin isolation. Commended for technology and innovation. Recognized for long-distance touring capability. Widely regarded as one of the most advanced vehicles Mercedes-Benz has ever produced. The odometer is hovering around the 17,435-mile mark, and it is STILL COVERED by the factory. With approximately 516 horsepower and 631 lb-ft of torque, the EQS combines flagship luxury with impressive performance. The large high-voltage battery provides an EPA-estimated range of approximately 340 miles for the EQS 580 4MATIC sedan configuration. The EQS 580's dual-motor electric powertrain delivers instantaneous torque, silent operation, and seamless acceleration. Unlike a traditional gasoline-powered luxury sedan, the electric drivetrain provides immediate response while eliminating engine vibration and noise. The result is a remarkably serene driving experience that perfectly complements the vehicle's flagship mission. The exterior styling is unmistakably futuristic. Smooth aerodynamic surfaces, elegant proportions, and sophisticated lighting elements help the EQS achieve one of the lowest drag coefficients of any production vehicle while creating a design unlike anything else in the luxury-sedan segment. Inside, the cabin showcases Mercedes-Benz at its finest. Rich Nappa leather, natural wood trim, massage seating, advanced climate-control systems, premium materials, and meticulous craftsmanship create an environment that rivals the world's most prestigious luxury automobiles. Technology is one of the EQS's defining strengths. The Head-Up Display, MBUX interfaces, advanced digital displays, voice-control capability, smartphone integration, Bluetooth connectivity, navigation functionality, and connected services help create an exceptionally advanced ownership experience. Certain connected services may require subscription. Safety and driver-assistance technologies include advanced braking systems, stability control, traction control, multiple airbags, and a variety of active and passive safety systems designed to enhance confidence behind the wheel. ...and there's SO MUCH more! However, they agreed to repurchase the vehicle to promote customer satisfaction. We have full documentation from the manufacturer available on site for review. BUY WITH CONFIDENCE! Over 125 components are inspected by Audi trained technicians to ensure each Audi Certified pre-owned vehicle is in optimal condition. Only after this comprehensive dealer inspection are we confident in backing the vehicle with our Audi Certified pre-owned Limited Warranty, which is more than a seal of approval, it's a badge of honor. When the Audi New Vehicle Limited Warranty expires, the Audi Certified pre-owned Limited Warranty becomes effective and provides coverage for a period of one year or 20,000 miles, whichever occurs first. (See dealer for details)..What the reviews say...Pleasant driving experience, plenty of space in the rear seat and cargo area, responsive powertrain. Previously, the Audi A5 Sportback was an ostensibly more practical four-door version of the slinky A5 coupe. That relationship changes multilaterally for 2025, however, as the A5 coupe and convertible are discontinued, and Audi streamlines its lineup. The now four-door-only A5 also serves as a replacement for the A4 sedan. Audi says the new A5 Sedan is longer, wider, and taller than the current A5 Sportback. The wheelbase is stretched, helping to provide good rear-seat and cargo space. In addition to the all-new styling for the slope-backed four-door, the level of equipment improves with navigation, wireless smartphone charging, and a power hatch coming standard. A turbocharged 2.0-liter four-cylinder with 268 horsepower and a 48-volt hybrid system is the only powertrain. A DSG dual-clutch transmission handles gear swaps, and all-wheel drive is standard. We'd choose the new A5 over the outgoing Sportback model, and we'd upgrade to the mid-range Premium Plus trim. Doing so adds desirable features such as upgraded ambient interior lighting, a heated steering wheel, lane-centering for the adaptive cruise control system, parking sensors, and a Bang & Olufsen stereo system. Premium Plus models also feature a panoramic glass roof, which lets the sun shine into the A5's cabin for an airier vibe. The new A5's slight boost in overall output, combined with the instantaneous torque boost of the hybrid system, makes for a quicker A5. We got it to 60 mph in 5.2 seconds in our testing. The new A5 presents a large, curved glass panel that houses an 11.9-inch instrument panel display and a 14.5-inch infotainment touchscreen. Audi says the new A5 Sedan provides 26 cubic feet of cargo space.

LOCAL TRADE, The 2024 BMW 4 Series 430i Gran Coupe is an outstanding choice for drivers who want the sporty performance and luxury of a BMW coupe combined with the practicality of a four-door hatchback. Blending elegant styling, advanced technology, impressive efficiency, and everyday versatility, the 430i Gran Coupe offers a unique driving experience that stands out in the luxury compact segment. Powering the 430i Gran Coupe is a turbocharged 2.0-liter BMW TwinPower Turbo 4-cylinder engine producing 255 horsepower and 295 lb-ft of torque. Paired with a responsive 8-speed automatic transmission, the powertrain delivers smooth acceleration, excellent fuel economy, and confident passing power. Whether you're navigating city streets, commuting to work, or taking a weekend road trip, the 430i provides the perfect balance of performance and efficiency. One of the biggest reasons to choose the 430i Gran Coupe is its distinctive design. Unlike a traditional sedan, the Gran Coupe features a sleek fastback roofline that gives it the appearance of a sporty coupe while maintaining the convenience of four doors. Its aggressive front fascia, athletic stance, sculpted body lines, and signature BMW styling create a premium look that turns heads everywhere it goes. Inside, the cabin is modern, luxurious, and driver-focused. High-quality materials, premium craftsmanship, and thoughtful ergonomics create an upscale atmosphere that reflects BMW's reputation for excellence. Comfortable seating, available leather upholstery, ambient lighting, and refined trim accents elevate every drive. The spacious interior offers ample room for passengers while maintaining the sporty character expected from the 4 Series lineup. Technology is another standout feature. The 2024 430i Gran Coupe comes equipped with BMW's latest curved display featuring a fully digital instrument cluster and central touchscreen running BMW Operating System 8.5. Wireless Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, navigation, voice controls, Bluetooth connectivity, and advanced smartphone integration ensure you stay connected and entertained on every journey. Practicality is where the Gran Coupe truly shines. The large rear hatch opens to reveal a generous cargo area that is significantly more versatile than a traditional sedan trunk. Fold-down rear seats provide additional flexibility, making it easy to transport luggage, sports equipment, shopping, or larger items while maintaining luxury-car comfort. BMW's legendary driving dynamics remain a major selling point. Precise steering, balanced handling, and a well-tuned suspension create a driving experience that feels engaging and confident. The 430i Gran Coupe delivers the sporty feel enthusiasts expect while remaining comfortable enough for daily driving. Safety is equally impressive, with advanced driver-assistance technologies including forward collision warning, automatic emergency braking, blind-spot monitoring, lane departure warning, and available adaptive cruise control helping provide peace of mind behind the wheel. The 2024 BMW 4 Series 430i Gran Coupe successfully combines luxury, performance, technology, and practicality into one stylish package. The Certified 2024 Honda Civic Si in Sonic Grey Pearl is a sporty, modern, and well-balanced compact sedan that blends exciting performance with everyday practicality. Designed for drivers who want a fun driving experience without giving up comfort or reliability, the Civic Si stands out with its aggressive styling, sharp handling, and refined interior. Finished in the popular Sonic Grey Pearl exterior color, this vehicle has a bold yet sophisticated look that highlights its sporty character while maintaining a clean, upscale appearance.

As a Honda Certified vehicle, this Civic Si has gone through a detailed inspection process to ensure it meets Hondas strict quality standards. This certification provides added peace of mind, offering reassurance that the vehicle has been carefully evaluated for performance, condition, and reliability. It also adds extra value for buyers looking for a dependable sporty sedan backed by Hondas trusted reputation.

On the outside, the 2024 Civic Si features a sleek and athletic design with a low stance, sharp body lines, and aggressive styling elements that set it apart from standard Civic models. The Sonic Grey Pearl finish enhances its modern and performance-focused look, giving it a unique presence on the road. Sporty details such as the honeycomb grille, rear spoiler, and dual exhaust outlets further emphasize its performance-oriented design.

Inside, the Civic Si offers a driver-focused cabin designed to enhance the driving experience. The interior features sport seats with excellent support, red-accented stitching, and high-quality materials throughout. The layout is clean and modern, placing important controls within easy reach of the driver. The seating is comfortable for both short commutes and longer drives, while still maintaining the sporty feel expected from an Si model.

Under the hood, the 2024 Civic Si is powered by a turbocharged 1.5-liter four-cylinder engine that delivers strong, responsive performance. Paired with a precise manual transmission, the Civic Si provides an engaging and connected driving experience that driving enthusiasts appreciate. Its sharp steering and well-tuned suspension make it agile and fun to drive, whether on winding roads or daily commutes.

Technology is well integrated into the Civic Si, featuring a modern touchscreen infotainment system with Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, Bluetooth connectivity, USB ports, and a premium audio setup. These features help keep drivers connected, entertained, and informed while maintaining focus on the road.

Safety is also a key strength of the Civic Si. It comes equipped with Honda Sensing, a suite of advanced driver-assistance features that includes Collision Mitigation Braking System, Lane Keeping Assist System, Road Departure Mitigation, Adaptive Cruise Control, and Forward Collision Warning. These systems work together to enhance driver awareness and overall safety.

The 2024 Honda Civic Si in Sonic Grey Pearl combines sporty performance, modern technology, everyday comfort, and Honda Certified reliability into one exciting package. It is an excellent choice for drivers who want a compact sedan that is both practical and fun to drive, offering a perfect balance between performance and dependability.

description: EXQUISITE, FUTURISTIC, SERENE, NO-ACCIDENT, ONE-OWNER, NONSMOKER, EXTRAORDINARY! The 2022 Mercedes-Benz EQS 580 4MATIC with ALL-WHEEL DRIVE represents one of the most ambitious luxury automobiles ever produced. As Mercedes-Benz's flagship electric sedan, it combines breathtaking technology, remarkable refinement, exceptional electric performance, and long-distance comfort into a package that feels years ahead of its time. Its advanced dual-motor all-wheel-drive system enhances confidence during changing weather conditions while delivering effortless acceleration, and its sleek aerodynamic design helps maximize efficiency. In many ways, the EQS serves as the electric equivalent of the legendary S-Class, bringing the brand's ''The Best or Nothing'' philosophy into the EV era. One of the EQS's greatest advantages is how completely it redefines luxury electric transportation. While competitors such as the Tesla Model S, BMW i7, Lucid Air, and Porsche Taycan each offer compelling strengths, the EQS distinguishes itself through exceptional ride comfort, near-silent operation, outstanding aerodynamic efficiency, and a cabin that feels more like a luxury lounge than a traditional automobile. Few EVs place as much emphasis on passenger comfort and refinement. Many journalists arrived expecting to evaluate a luxury EV ... but many departed sounding more like ambassadors for the future of luxury motoring. Named to numerous Car and Driver Editors' Choice lists. Recognized as one of the world's premier luxury electric sedans. Praised by Car and Driver for its extraordinary comfort, technology, and refinement. Commended by Edmunds for its quiet cabin, impressive range, and luxury appointments. Frequently ranked among the most technologically advanced production vehicles available. Widely regarded as the electric flagship of the Mercedes-Benz lineup. The odometer is hovering around the 8,436-mile mark, and it is STILL COVERED by the factory. New Vehicle Limited Warranty Coverage expires November 15, 2027 or 50,000 miles. Approximately 41,564 miles of coverage remain. High-Voltage Battery Warranty Coverage expires November 15, 2033 or 155,000 miles. Approximately 146,564 miles of coverage remain. Want to extend its warranty coverage? In most cases, we can provide expanded options to cover each vehicle with a valuable, comprehensive warranty for years to come! Mercedes-Benz engineers approached the EQS as though they were creating a rolling technology showcase ... then remembered it also needed to be one of the most luxurious sedans in the world. This particular EQS 580 4MATIC rises well above standard specification with an impressive collection of premium factory enhancements. Exclusive Trim Package Multi-Contour Front Seats with Massage Feature -- Enhances long-distance comfort and support. Rapid Heating Front Seats -- Helps warm occupants more quickly in cold weather. Four-Zone Climate Control -- Allows individualized comfort settings throughout the cabin. AIR-BALANCE Package -- Helps enhance cabin ambiance and air quality. AMG Line Interior Multi-Function Sport Steering Wheel -- Adds a more athletic driving experience. AMG Sport Seats -- Feature integrated headrests and enhanced support. AMG Stainless Steel Drive Pedals -- Provide a sport-inspired appearance. AMG Interior Styling Enhancements -- Elevate the cabin's visual appeal. Standalone Features MBUX Augmented Reality Head-Up Display -- Projects advanced navigation and driving information directly into the driver's field of view. HEPA Filtration with Energizing Air Control Plus -- Helps improve cabin air quality. Heated Steering Wheel -- Enhances cold-weather comfort. 21'' AMG Multi-Spoke Wheels with Black Accents -- Add a distinctive performance-inspired appearance. MANUFAKTUR Selenite Grey Magno Finish -- Creates an exceptionally sophisticated visual presence. Natural Grain Anthracite Wood Trim -- Adds warmth and craftsmanship throughout the cabin. Anthracite Linden Wood Center Console Trim -- Further elevates interior luxury. The EQS 580 4MATIC delivers 516 horsepower and 631 lb-ft of torque through dual electric motors and a 107.8-kWh battery pack. Equipped with the factory 21-inch AMG wheels, this configuration delivers an EPA-estimated driving range of approximately 340 miles on a full charge. Charging flexibility is one of the EQS's greatest strengths. Level 1 Charging (120V Household Outlet) Approximately 4 to 5 miles of range per hour of charging -- Useful for occasional charging needs. Level 2 Charging (240V Home or Public Charging) Approximately 11 to 12 hours for a full charge -- Ideal for overnight charging. DC Fast Charging Approximately 31 minutes from 10% to 80% charge under ideal conditions -- Excellent for long-distance travel. Up to approximately 200 kW charging capability -- Helps minimize charging stops. The 2022 Mercedes-Benz EQS 580 4MATIC comes standard with dual-motor all-wheel drive, adaptive air suspension, rear-wheel steering, LED lighting, advanced driver-assistance technologies, premium interior materials, heated front seats, navigation, wireless smartphone integration, digital instrumentation, and one of the most advanced luxury-car platforms ever developed by Mercedes-Benz. The defining mechanical strength of the EQS is its ability to deliver extraordinary luxury without sacrificing performance. Its dual electric motors generate an impressive 516 horsepower while providing instantaneous torque delivery unavailable from conventional combustion engines. The advanced battery system supplies energy efficiently while helping achieve excellent range, and regenerative braking helps recover energy during deceleration. Adaptive air suspension continuously adjusts to changing road conditions, while rear-wheel steering improves maneuverability in tight spaces and enhances stability at highway speeds. The result is a vehicle that feels remarkably smooth, effortless, and composed regardless of driving conditions. The exterior design is unlike anything else wearing a Mercedes-Benz badge. Its sleek, highly aerodynamic silhouette helps maximize efficiency while creating a futuristic appearance. The MANUFAKTUR Selenite Grey Magno finish gives the EQS an especially sophisticated presence, while the factory 21-inch AMG multi-spoke wheels with black accents add a sportier visual character. Flush door handles, flowing body surfaces, and distinctive LED lighting help create a design that remains instantly recognizable day or night. Inside, the cabin feels more like a private executive lounge than a traditional automobile. Premium leather seating surfaces, AMG sport seats, natural wood trim, massage functionality, four-zone climate control, rapid-heating front seats, and a heated steering wheel create a remarkably comfortable environment. The combination of Anthracite wood finishes and AMG interior enhancements produces a sophisticated blend of luxury and athleticism. Passenger accommodations are exceptionally generous, and the serene atmosphere encourages effortless long-distance travel. Technology is a centerpiece of the EQS experience. The advanced MBUX infotainment platform delivers navigation, media, vehicle controls, and connectivity through an intuitive digital environment. The Augmented Reality Head-Up Display projects navigation instructions and vehicle information directly into the driver's field of view, helping reduce distractions. Connected services, navigation enhancements, and certain online features may require subscription. The system's speed, responsiveness, and sophistication help place the EQS among the most technologically advanced luxury vehicles ever produced. Safety and driver assistance technologies are equally impressive. Advanced systems include active braking assistance, blind-spot monitoring, lane-keeping assistance, adaptive cruise functionality, parking assistance technologies, multiple camera systems, traffic-sign recognition, electronic stability systems, and an extensive suite of occupant-protection technologies. The hands-free liftgate, keyless entry, and push-start button simplify access and operation, complemented by memory seats and heated seats for personalized comfort. The surround sound system and HD radio elevate audio quality, making every drive enjoyable. This vehicle combines cutting-edge technology with user-friendly controls, making it a versatile and convenient choice for modern drivers. 2022 Genesis G70 Safety and Security Features This G70 offers comprehensive safety with automatic emergency braking at the rear and at intersections, helping to prevent collisions. Brembo premium brakes provide confident stopping power, while the pre-collision warning system vibrates the seat belt to alert you of potential hazards. The vehicle exit safety system enhances door safety, and traffic sign recognition with adaptive speed limiting aids in maintaining safe driving speeds. Front and knee airbags—specifically for the driver—and four-wheel ABS ensure occupant protection in the event of a crash. Power door locks include anti-lockout features, adding to the overall security of this sedan. 2022 Genesis G70 Entertainment and Technology Features Stay connected and entertained with Genesis Connect smart device app compatibility, allowing remote engine start and cabin preconditioning. The 10.25-inch infotainment touchscreen provides easy access to all multimedia functions, including voice-operated hands-free phone calls and radio controls. An HD radio and internet radio app like Pandora offer a variety of listening options, while the surround sound system and dual subwoofers deliver immersive audio quality. The touch screen display ensures intuitive control, making every drive more enjoyable and convenient. 2022 Genesis G70 Performance Features The G70’s performance is enhanced by a limited-slip differential at the rear, providing improved traction during spirited driving. The sport-tuned suspension delivers sharp handling and responsive cornering, making this sedan fun to drive whether on city streets or winding roads. These features combine to create a dynamic driving experience that emphasizes agility and stability, all while maintaining comfort and sophistication.

These features combine to create a connected, user-friendly experience, making every drive more enjoyable and safe. 2022 Dodge Charger Performance Features Performance is a key aspect of this Dodge Charger R/T, with a performance exhaust system that enhances sound and power delivery. These performance features work together to provide a dynamic driving experience, whether you're accelerating on the highway or carving corners on back roads.
